title: Joining Partway Through the Year: Join Shares in the 2026-27 UIL Academic and Robotics Fee Schedule, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
For a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the 2026-27 UIL Academic and Robotics fee schedule of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** applies a join share by the registration date of the participation. The schedule's dates are: first practice 2026-08-03, spring semester start 2027-01-04, last school day 2027-05-27; the school year counts 40 weeks.

**Clause.** A registration date on or after 2027-01-04 pays the spring-semester share of 50 percent. A registration date more than 28 calendar days after 2026-08-03 but before 2027-01-04 is prorated by whole weeks: the whole weeks from the registration date to 2027-05-27, out of 40, as a percentage never above 100. Any other registration date pays the full-year fee (100 percent).

**Counting.** Calendar days are counted from 2026-08-03 to the registration date. Whole weeks are the calendar days from the registration date to 2027-05-27 divided by 7, any part week dropped; the share is those whole weeks out of 40, expressed as a percentage.

## Boundaries and cases (hypothetical registration dates)

| Registration date | Calendar days after 2026-08-03 | Method | Join share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-31 | 28 | full-year | 100 percent |
| 2026-09-01 | 29 | prorated: 268 days, 38 whole weeks of 40 | 95 percent |
| 2026-09-22 | 50 | prorated: 247 days, 35 whole weeks of 40 | 87.5 percent |
| 2026-11-18 | 107 | prorated: 190 days, 27 whole weeks of 40 | 67.5 percent |
| 2027-01-03 | 153 | prorated: 144 days, 20 whole weeks of 40 | 50 percent |
| 2027-01-04 | on or after the spring start | spring-semester share | 50 percent |

The 28-day boundary is strict: 28 days after 2026-08-03 still pays the full-year fee, 29 days is prorated. The spring boundary is inclusive: 2027-01-04 itself takes the spring-semester share.
